name: run_celltypist_annotate
description: Annotate single-cell expression with CellTypist using a provider-converted data-only model archive. The live service never downloads or deserializes upstream pickle files.

adata_path.description: An .h5ad file inside the provider data directory containing log1p-normalized expression to 10,000 counts per cell.

model.description: Provider-approved CellTypist model identity; the server maps it to a safe .npz archive.

majority_voting.description: Refine predictions by CellTypist over-clustering when the dataset has more than 50 cells.

artifact_format.description: Safe provider artifact format used for inference.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the reviewed upstream model source.

predicted_labels.description: Predicted cell-type label per cell (aligned with cell_ids).

label_counts.description: Cell-type label -> number of cells assigned to it.

error.description: Error description if the run failed.
